verdict.rationale: Asana documents app components that let developers plug their app directly into the Asana UI on the surface of tasks or rules, backed by a published app components OpenAPI spec. That is a first-party native UI extension point, but it is limited to task and rule surfaces rather than custom views or dashboard widgets. Missing for 10: building custom project views, dashboard or reporting widgets, documentation of how components render natively and what design system they use, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
